per_question.question: What are the top 5 best-selling genres by total sales?
per_question.sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5;

per_question.question: List all albums by the artist 'AC/DC'.
per_question.sql: SELECT Album.* FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC';

per_question.question: What are the names and email addresses of customers from Brazil?
per_question.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

per_question.question: What is the most popular media type based on number of tracks?
per_question.sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1;

per_question.question: Which employee has the most customers assigned to them?
per_question.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1;
per_question.model_answer: EmployeeId: 3, FirstName: Jane, LastName: Peacock, CustomerCount: 21

per_question.question: How many tracks are there in each playlist?
per_question.sql: SELECT p.Name AS PlaylistName, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY p.Name;

per_question.question: What is the total revenue generated in the year 2021?
per_question.sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021';

per_question.question: What is the average invoice total for each billing country, ordered from highest to lowest?
per_question.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AverageTotal DESC

per_question.question: For each customer, what is their total spending and how does it rank compared to other customers? Show the top 5 customers by spending.
per_question.sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, TotalSpending, Rank FROM (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpending, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC) AS Rank FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId) ranked WHERE Rank <= 5 ORDER BY Rank;

per_question.question: Which artists have tracks in more than 3 different genres? List the artist name and the number of distinct genres.
per_question.sql: SELECT a.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3;
